name: Rye Brook Day Camp
operator_name: Village of Rye Brook Parks & Recreation
description_short: Village day camp for children entering kindergarten to 6th grade, six weeks from July 6 to August 14, 2026, sold by the week or for the full season, with weekly trips and end of season performances.
notes: Non-resident rates shown. Residents pay $415 for one week up to $1,565 for six weeks, or $1,415 for six weeks if registered before May 1. Additional children pay less.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Day Camp page: 2026 Rye Brook Day Camp July 6 through August 14; forms due June 20; sample schedule and end of season performance video. Phone, email and the Recreation office address (938 King Street, Rye Brook, NY 10573) in the sidebar; ZIP is from that office address, as the page does not say where camp meets. Session price is the non-resident 6 week rate from the fee page.

Researched by Claude from this page. Day Camp Fee Schedule 2026, K to 6th grades. Non-resident first child: 1 week $545, 2 weeks $930, 3 weeks $1,240, 4 weeks $1,445, 5 weeks $1,815, 6 weeks $2,165. Residents after 5/1: $415 a week to $1,565 for 6 weeks; residents before 5/1: $1,415 for 6 weeks. Sibling discounts. Ages derived from grades.
